description: This file provides Windows compatibility definitions and stubs for MinGW-w64, including type definitions, macro replacements, and function implementations to emulate POSIX behavior on Windows.

methods.name: mingw_mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory with specified mode, emulating POSIX mkdir on Windows.

methods.name: mingw_kill
methods.description: Sends a signal to a process, emulating kill on Windows.

methods.name: mingw_locate_in_PATH
methods.description: Locates an executable in the system PATH.

methods.name: mingw_unlink
methods.description: Deletes a file, with special handling for in-use errors.

methods.name: mingw_open
methods.description: Opens a file, emulating POSIX open.

methods.name: mingw_fgetc
methods.description: Gets a character from a file stream.

methods.name: mingw_write
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor.

methods.name: win32_fsync_no_flush
methods.description: Flushes file data without OS cache flush.

methods.name: getrlimit
methods.description: Retrieves resource limits, specifically for NOFILE.

methods.name: mingw_lstat
methods.description: Retrieves file status, including nanosecond timestamps.

methods.name: mingw_fstat
methods.description: Retrieves file status from file descriptor.

methods.name: mingw_utime
methods.description: Sets file access and modification times.

methods.name: mingw_execvp
methods.description: Executes a program, replacing current process.

methods.name: git_ntohl
methods.description: Converts network byte order to host byte order.

methods.name: winansi_isatty
methods.description: Checks if file descriptor is a terminal.

methods.name: winansi_get_osfhandle
methods.description: Gets OS handle from file descriptor.
